full_judgment: "(a) Out of total of 20.97 acres acquired on payment of full compensation under Gazette Notification 4.19 acres actually under use of PWD may be retained and the rest 16.78 acres declared khas and restored to the original owners and settle the same with them by releasing salami at present market price. If they declined to take settlement at market price, processes should be taken to evict the present occupiers and bring the lands fully under possession of the PW D."
